findings.title: The return as an answer-form
findings.claim: The command to speak and the final return meet in a response-shaped reading: the utterance announces a return, while the death-and-return sequence itself can function as an indication.

findings.containment: The focus does not identify a prior denial or the recipient of an answer; the answer and indication readings remain attributed possibilities.
